protocol.gate: All full-solve solutions must converge and pass independent feasibility/KKT/equivalence. At least 5x aggregate full-contact CPU speedup at BOTH accuracies and no worse observed full-solve worst latency. Core timings alone cannot pass.

notes: CPU includes common scalar bookkeeping; per-call wall timings include allocation/GC. Pure optimizer omits reconstruction and original scalar polish; do not mix work units. No hardware GPU involved.
decision: STOP — gate failed; no further rescue or production integration
